programs.title: Toi Time
programs.desc: The Toi Time whanau find out what letters are and how different languages use different letters. Aunty Anika shows us how important it is to tidy our room.

programs.title: Waabiny Time
programs.desc: The team explore some of the words the Noongar people use for the ocean, and the animals that live in the sea.

programs.desc: The birds decide to get away from the noise of the city. Unfortunately, the Humans have the same idea. What are they doing now?

programs.title: Aussie Bush Tales
programs.desc: Moort's family is surprised when a huge bird crashes into the snowy mountain near where they are sheltering.

programs.title: The Mysterious Cities Of Gold
programs.desc: Our heroes manage to escape the jaws of Pang-Zi's alligator, thanks to a strange little man who walks with a casual self-assurance into the middle of the astonished pirates and creates a diversion.

programs.title: Bushwhacked
programs.desc: Brandon gives Kayne his next mission - to find a Tassie devil and kiss it! With the help of a local 'devil whisperer' they track down a den inhabited by a feisty devil family, but will Kayne kiss one?
